title: Thrust Reverser — Performance Credit and Landing Distance

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Performance entry covering the credit taken for thrust reverser use in landing distance, the cases in which no credit may be taken and the effect of one reverser inoperative.

sections.purpose: This entry states when credit may be taken for thrust reverser use in the landing distance calculation and how the calculation changes with one reverser inoperative.
sections.description: The certified landing distance is computed without reverser credit on a dry runway, so the reversers contribute margin rather than performance in that case. On a contaminated runway the published data does take credit for both reversers, and that credit is significant: on a wet or slush-covered surface the difference between reverser credit and no credit can be several hundred metres. Where one reverser is inoperative, the contaminated runway data must be entered with the single-reverser correction, and where both are inoperative no credit may be taken at all. The credit assumes the reverser deploys promptly and symmetrically; a reverser that deploys slowly or asymmetrically does not deliver the assumed decelerating force in the first seconds after touchdown, which is where most of the benefit lies. Crews should therefore report a reverser that feels slow or that produces a yaw at deployment, even when it eventually deploys fully and no fault is annunciated.
sections.crew_procedure: Compute the landing distance with the reverser configuration actually available, using the single-reverser correction where one is inoperative and no credit where both are. On a contaminated runway, select reverse promptly at touchdown and maintain it to the speed given in the procedure. Report any reverser that deploys slowly or asymmetrically in the technical log, describing what was felt rather than what was annunciated.
sections.limitation_note: No reverser credit may be taken with both reversers inoperative. Where one is inoperative, only the single-reverser contaminated runway data may be used, and dispatch is subject to the applicable minimum equipment list item.

type_data.crew_action: Compute the landing distance for the reverser configuration available; report slow or asymmetric deployment.
